description.value:
You touch a creature and activate its latent regeneration to cure it of one of the following physical conditions:

  • 2 stacks of @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.R54LQEKSDXNQ3N75]{Bleeding}.
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.ADW4EH0NKRDCRCA4]{Blinded}
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.WK17M9FZR08DRUP1]{Deafened}
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.9YPWLY1IHQV3MRLO]{Diseased}; only one if the target is afflicted by multiple diseases. Some diseases require Greater Restoration to be cured instead.
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.FIKTMW8NEOFEAKG6]{Hobbled}
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.OBTES08D2XC130IG]{Paralyzed}
  • @Compendium[undertaking.conditions.9X088PM7H5U2S1HQ]{Sickened}
